name: elevenlabs-editorial
title: ElevenLabs Editorial
description: Editorial print-magazine theme from the ElevenLabs design system: off-white canvas (#f5f5f5), warm near-black ink pill primary, pastel atmospheric gradient orbs (mint/peach/lavender/sky/rose) as chart & decoration palette. Waldenburg Light display (sub: EB Garamond), Inter body. Chat bubble palette: sage outgoing / warm off-white incoming.

@layer utilities..bg-orb-mint: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--orb-mint) 0%, transparent 70%);
@layer utilities..bg-orb-peach: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--orb-peach) 0%, transparent 70%);
@layer utilities..bg-orb-lavender: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--orb-lavender) 0%, transparent 70%);
@layer utilities..bg-orb-sky: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--orb-sky) 0%, transparent 70%);
@layer utilities..bg-orb-rose: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--orb-rose) 0%, transparent 70%);

docs: ElevenLabs design system preset. Install: npx shadcn add ./elevenlabs-theme.json (merges into globals.css). Mapping: canvas #f5f5f5 = background; surface-card = card; surface-strong = secondary/muted/accent; muted #777169 = muted-foreground; hairline = border; hairline-strong = input; primary = ink pill #292524 (press: --primary-active); chart-1..5 = the five gradient orb pastels (decoration only, never fills/text); dark mode = canvas-deep #0c0a09 with surface-dark-elevated cards and inverted white pill primary. Radius: --radius 0.75rem => rounded-xl 16px (cards, on spec), rounded-md 10px (inputs, spec 8px: add rounded-sm for pixel-perfect), rounded-lg 12px (compact cards). CTAs are pills: add className="rounded-full" to Button (design forbids sharp CTAs). Display font: use utility "font-display" for Waldenburg/EB Garamond headlines, weight 300 + negative tracking per spec (never bold). Load fonts via next/font or <link> (Inter + EB Garamond substitute; Waldenburg is licensed). Dark destructive lightened to #ef4444 for AA contrast on #0c0a09. Chat bubbles: own messages = bg-bubble-out text-bubble-out-foreground (#E4EDE6 sage / #213628 deep moss text, optional border-bubble-out-border #D2DFD5); received = bg-bubble-in text-bubble-in-foreground (#F4F3F1 / #0c0a09). Dark mode derived: outgoing deep sage #263A2E with sage text #E4EDE6, incoming = elevated card #1c1917.
